80839.subject: 🔷 The Daily: Coinbase outlines Bitcoin's post-quantum priorities
80839.body:
Coinbase outlines priorities for Bitcoin's post-quantum migration | Richard Heart reportedly detained in Istanbul | Standard Chartered pushes $2 trillion stablecoin forecast to 2030 | Strive buys $235 million in bitcoin | Evernorth taps Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo to put XRP treasury to work

The Daily ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by Yogita Khatri | Edited by Jason Shubnell

Presented By:

( https://polymarket.us/?deep_link_sub1=THEBLOCK&c=NEWSLETTER&shortlink=94gey3fp&source_caller=api_v2&onelink_id=S8ac&pid=THEBLOCK&deep_link_value=midterms&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Happy Wednesday! *Bitcoin* ( https://www.theblock.co/price/bitcoin?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) fell below ( https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-10-14-bitcoin-falls-below-82000-core-inflation-fed-rate-hike-418582?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) *$82,000* after hotter-than-expected core U.S. inflation data raised concerns about further Fed rate hikes.

In today's newsletter, *Coinbase* outlines its priorities for Bitcoin's post-quantum migration, Hex and PulseChain founder *Richard Heart* is reportedly detained in Istanbul, *Standard Chartered* pushes its $2 trillion stablecoin market forecast to 2030, and more.

Meanwhile, *BNY* and *Citadel Securities* complete ( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-10-14-bny-citadel-securities-complete-treasury-repo-in-first-use-of-tokenized-assets-on-major-triparty-platform-418534?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) a Treasury repo using tokenized assets, a major *SkyAI* shareholder raises ( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-10-14-solana-treasury-skyai-bastion-sol-sales-tender-offer-418598?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) concerns after its Solana treasury shrinks 70% in a month, and *Kalshi* 's CEO defends ( https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-10-14-youre-committing-crime-broad-daylight-kalshi-ceo-defends-prediction-markets-insider-trading-concerns-418601?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) prediction markets over insider trading concerns.
